name: kimi-git-flow
description: Kimi Code plugin that turns every code change into a clean, reviewable update on GitHub.
skillInstructions: When the user asks for a code change in a git repo, follow the kimi-git-flow procedure: create a fresh branch named `kimi/<slug>` from the default branch, commit the change on it, push and open a pull request with `gh pr create --fill`, wait for required checks with `gh pr checks --watch`, then land the change with `gh pr merge --squash` once green (the remote branch is kept by default; pass `--delete-branch` only when `KIMI_GIT_FLOW_DELETE_REMOTE_BRANCH=1`), and switch the working copy back to the default branch. Never force-push the default branch; never merge a pull request with failing checks; never skip branch-protection rules.

interface.shortDescription: Branch → pull request → wait for checks → land, one branch per change.
interface.longDescription: Kimi Code plugin that turns every code change into a clean, reviewable update on GitHub. Creates an isolated branch, opens a pull request, waits for the required checks, and lands the change automatically. Exposes slash commands (/branch, /pr, /watch, /merge, /status, /back-to-main) for fine-grained control. GitHub-only; uses `gh` and `git` directly.
